description: This file defines a React context provider and hook for managing the selection state of input parameters on an asset details page within a React application. It provides state normalization, context creation, and access mechanisms for other components.

methods.name: InputParameterSelectionProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides context for selected input parameter ID and manages its state with normalization.

methods.name: useInputParameterSelection
methods.description: A custom hook to access the input parameter selection context, must be used within the provider.
